headline: Site plan and special permit review for 179-unit apartment project at 37 Enon Street, plus one-way street proposal for part of Chase Street.
summary: The Commission will review a recommendation to make part of Chase Street one-way, and a site plan and special permit for a new 179-unit apartment building with retail space at 37 Enon Street. It will also discuss traffic safety concerns at two intersections and hear a construction update on 119 Rantoul Street.
items: Recommendation to City Council on Order #234-2026 to make part of Chase Street, from West Dane Street to Roundy Street, a one-way street

Recommendation to the Planning Board on Site Plan Review (SPR 26-42) and Special Permit (SP-26-5) for 37 Enon Street: 179 apartments, about 2,600 sf retail space, and 281 parking spaces where 367 are required, with a Special Permit for 1.5 parking spaces per unit
Review of traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at Pickett Street and Baker Ave
Review of traffic and pedestrian safety concerns at Peabody Avenue, Larcom Avenue and Sargent Avenue
Construction update on 119 Rantoul Street (Wendell Holmes LLC) - no update, still under construction
location: Temporary Beverly City Hall, 1st Floor Conference Room, 195 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA
